class.name: NNAction
class.brief_description: A single step performed while an [NNBehaviour] is active.
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNBehaviour] or [NNActionGroup] to represent one step of a behaviour. Connect to [signal action_entered], [signal frame_tick], and [signal action_exited] to run your action logic, then set [member NNActions.is_finished] to [code]true[/code] when the step completes so the agent advances. An [NNAction] can also host a nested AI root (such as an [NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], [NNHTNRoot], or another [NNAgent]) as a child. The hosted root runs while this action is active and, when [member finish_from_hosted_root] is [code]true[/code], its completion automatically finishes or fails the action.

members.member: Optional user-defined ID for identifying this action in scripts without relying on node names.

If [code]true[/code], finishing a hosted child root automatically marks this action finished (and failed if the root failed). Set to [code]false[/code] to handle completion yourself via [signal hosted_root_finished].

signal.name: action_entered
signal.description: Emitted when this action starts executing.

signal.name: action_exited
signal.description: Emitted when this action finishes, fails, or is interrupted.

signal.name: frame_tick
signal.description: Emitted on every agent step while this action is active.

signal.name: hosted_root_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a hosted child root finishes its run.
